purpose: Test whether the residual V103 path-dependent regressions arise because LoadLeast substitutions protect only the current function's upstream inputs while ignoring the immutable nonterminal output's locality to already-warm immediate child containers.

trajectory_amplification.input_locality_pulse_E878: One accepted initializer window with four substitutions at frame 244 led to 1338 of 4000 later final-assignment windows differing, 207 fewer fixed-window completions, throughput -0.207 requests/ms and QPR -0.0004475893483.
trajectory_amplification.componentwise_pulse: Five unsafe candidates were rejected and all three pulse runs remained bit-for-bit assignment-equivalent to the V94 anchor.
trajectory_amplification.componentwise_spike: Eighteen accepted windows and twenty-three substitutions produced 1311 different final-assignment windows; mean latency was slightly lower but mean cost rose from 1.19475739 to 1.23982457 while throughput and QPR fell.
trajectory_amplification.interpretation: Current-player scalar and componentwise FaaSRank safety can still miss the effect of relocating a nonterminal output on its immediate children. A single accepted move can persist through container, queue and dependency state, so completed-request outcomes cannot be assigned to later individual moves.

structural_gap.upstream_only: V103 locality evaluates already-completed parent outputs entering the current player.
structural_gap.missing_downstream: The current player's output becomes an input to immutable immediate children, but V103 never checks its transfer potential to child containers already warm in the current snapshot.
structural_gap.why_current_state_only: Immutable DAG edges, function output size, directed bandwidth and current warm-container membership are available before placement and contain no completion, seed or burst-label outcome.

closed_alternatives.conditional_LoadLeast_window_certificate: closed as behaviorally inert by V102

allowed_online_inputs: immutable DAG parent and immediate-child relations
configured output size of the current function
current running warm-container membership for immediate child functions
current completed-parent placements for the current player
current pending plus resident task count by node
current node CPU and memory utilization snapshots
current running or existing container membership for the current player function
frozen terminal-OCS or nonterminal-FaaSRank routed score
forbidden_online_inputs: future child placement or future child feasibility

arms.per_substitution_safety: V103 input-parent locality noninferiority plus per-immediate-child downstream warm-container transfer-time noninferiority
arms.coordination_guard: exact V94 dual window-safe Pareto guard

arms.per_substitution_safety: V103 componentwise current-player noninferiority plus per-immediate-child downstream warm-container transfer-time noninferiority
arms.coordination_guard: exact V94 dual window-safe Pareto guard

candidate_mechanism.player_order: retain the exact V94 SRPT-ready order
candidate_mechanism.density_band: retain V103 eligibility: nonterminal substitutions only at queue density >=8 and every substitution only while whole-window density <24
candidate_mechanism.strict_load_improvement: candidate pending plus resident plus same-window projected count is strictly below anchor
candidate_mechanism.warm_preservation_common_floor: retain V103: a running-warm anchor may only move to a running-warm candidate
candidate_mechanism.upstream_input_locality_gate: candidate frozen FaaSRank current-parent locality component must be at least anchor locality within EPSILON

downstream_warm_child_gate.children: immutable immediate child functions derived by reversing the captured function-parent map
downstream_warm_child_gate.eligible_child_evidence: only child functions with at least one current running warm container constrain the move
downstream_warm_child_gate.per_child_score: minimum configured transfer time of the current function output from the proposed current-function node to any current warm container of that child; local transfer is zero and remote transfer is output_mb/directed_bandwidth
downstream_warm_child_gate.acceptance: for every constraining immediate child, candidate minimum transfer time must be no greater than anchor minimum transfer time within EPSILON
downstream_warm_child_gate.no_evidence: a child with no current warm container is neutral rather than guessed

componentwise_arm_additional_gate: candidate CPU headroom at least anchor CPU headroom within EPSILON
candidate memory headroom at least anchor memory headroom within EPSILON
candidate warm affinity at least anchor warm affinity within EPSILON
candidate diversity penalty no greater than anchor diversity penalty within EPSILON
candidate LoadLeast projected load strictly below anchor
complete_initializer_acceptance: at least one structurally safe substitution
candidate_mechanism.coordination_acceptance: exact V94 dual window-safe Pareto guard with no LoadLeast certificate
candidate_mechanism.exact_anchor_invariant: When no initializer substitution is accepted, each V104 candidate dispatches exactly the V94 assignment for identical current state and candidates.

selection.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection.E3_winner_requires: one candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection.multiple_passers: maximize the minimum relative mean QPR gain across scenarios and conventions, then maximize the minimum relative throughput change, then prefer componentwise-bidirectional over bidirectional locality, then arm_id
selection.frozen_E4_component: V97 v97-e4-load-guard64; no V104 E4 arm or result-dependent E4 reselection
selection.E3_pass_authorizes_only: a separately committed E966-E985 all-20-seed confirmation plan pairing the selected E3 profile with the already frozen V97 E4 profile
selection.failure_action: Freeze all 27 runs, keep E926-E985 and every other unopened seed untouched, do not replace seeds or selectively rerun scientific results, and return to mechanism diagnosis.
